actions.name: Scimitar

actions.desc: The bandit steals an object from one creature it can see within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 11 DEX save or lose one object it is wearing or carrying of the bandit's choice. The object must weigh no more than 10 pounds, can't be a weapon, and can't be wrapped around or firmly attached to the target, such as a shirt or armor.
